trans.sense: A state in the Midwestern US

examples.text: I prefer to think of Iowa as I saw it through the eyes of a ten-year-old boy. Those were eyes filled with the wonders of Iowa’s streams and woods, of the mystery of growing crops.

glosses: A state in the Midwestern region of the United States. Capital and largest city: Des Moines.
A tributary of the Mississippi River which flows through Iowa in a southeast direction.
A town in Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana.
